notes.title: Removal from Store!
notes.content:
This game might be removed from store....

I am not satisfied with its quality anymore...

This is what I think... since when I began GameDev I wanted to make the kind of games everyone would
love....

But well I am kind of an amateur lets put it that way....

What I mean by "Amateur" Is that I still have a long journey ahead of me when it comes to GameDev....
I am also right now working on the biggest project of my life.... And I want my future and past games to have that kind of same quality....

Gladiators IDLE was a game that I was very proud of.... It`s my first game that has an active fighting animation and that I am using a higher resolution character  as the lanista... Knights and Dungeons(was drawn art not pixel art)....

This is also my most complex game.... 
Even tough I am very proud of this project..... My fans prefer GK and KAD.

Anyways..... This game indeed posess multiple problems.... the code is a real mess.... I was a beginner at C3 when I made this... and these problems were adressed at the review section....

If I ever decide to remake this game It going to be (Gladiators IDLE 2) and then I would remake a total different game... because I think If I do change something in this game  I would have to change the whole game....

Anyways These changes are for the best! Big games are coming!

notes.title: MASSIVE CHANGES!
notes.content:
Due to lots of negative reviews! And since I worry a lot about my image I have decided to completely redesign and rebalance the game!

I also introduced new features changed some graphics and completely balanced even more this game!

I think the new system will be more pleasing to you guys!

* Death system
*Enemies Stages
*Training will now work as (amount of battles CD)
*The slave market will no longer refresh every 6000 seconds, you do now have the power to choose how strong and pricey you want your glad!
*Three different stages each one will give you a bonus to your char like ATK LIFE GOLDF.

Hope you like the new game if people massively dislike it tough I can still make a rollback!

AND ALSO PLEASE REPORT BUGS ON FORUMS!

Thanks!
